obligations.source_text: Create one independent complex reference-guided science-editorial test image in which a localized active-region solar flare is visibly testable without becoming a detached coronal event; use the attached portrait only as appearance guidance for an original adult fictional subject.

bindings.sun_phrase: Across the full observation, the solar disk or limb establishes the burst on the Sun
bindings.region_phrase: Within the visible photospheric field, a localized magnetically complex active region anchors the event
bindings.burst_phrase: At its core, an intense compact brightening or paired flare ribbons occur inside that region
bindings.response_phrase: Around the same site, short bright coronal loops or nearby plasma response remain connected to the burst
